$comment: Hand-reviewed corrections applied by scripts/extract-data.mjs on top of the Excel list and the clickdummy tree. Every entry cites its reason. The requirements document v1.6 (docs/sources) wins over every other source.

108.why: Excel type '?' (DATA.checks). IPv4 address; docx §8/§11 silent. Decided: IPv4 field with numeric keypad.

109.why: Excel type '?', default 'AA:AA:AA:AA' and alphabetical keyboard look like a copy error; a subnet mask is dotted-decimal like the other two.

110.why: Excel type '?'. Gateway is an IPv4 address.

246.why: Excel condition {247=249};{247=250} points at Batch Mode, which is unrelated to 'Printfunction via CAN-Input'. The CAN screen gates it on External_Canbus_Enable (238); recorded in OPEN-POINTS.

273.why: Excel has {269=271}&{269=272}: AND between two values of the same selection can never be true. Clearly meant as OR.

323.why: Excel colour '#fffff' is a 5-digit hex (DATA.checks). Dropped; status colours come from tokens.

608.why: Excel Val=502 is a language option id, not a logo option (copy error). Use the NOVEXX logo as the current value.

700.why: Info_Time is a String with a Number Keyboard in Excel; a time needs its own picker (docx §7.2 has no date/time control; recorded in OPEN-POINTS).

729.why: CRA_relevant_Target_Country is read-only level 4 with Editable=False; shown as a read-only value until PID defines the country selection.

sliders.why: docx §7.2 asks for a slider 'where a range is more intuitive' but the Excel marks no parameter as slider. Proposal: fixed speed, manual feed speed, speed modification %, test speed, stand-by timer. Recorded in OPEN-POINTS.

reservedOptions.why: Sensor_Type_Opt4–Opt10 are reserved on purpose (clickdummy report 'What changed'); hidden from the selection list (plan P2-06).

selectformat.why: docx §8.1: Access L1 (clickdummy said L2 to be confirmed).

usermanage.why: docx §8.14: L1/L2 own account, L3 list. L0 no access.

securecode.why: docx §8.15: visible from any level (clickdummy said L3).

usermodified.why: Diagram: 'List of User Modified Parameters'. Implemented as a generated list of parameters whose value differs from default (plan P3-13).

rewinder.why: Diagram note: only visible for the D-Series, enabled via crypto chip. Tile hidden unless seed/machine.json says D-Series.

buscard.why: 'Comes later', dynamic tile name from the detected card. Tile disabled unless seed/machine.json lists a bus card.

optionGates.$comment: Menu tiles that are disabled when the machine option is not installed (docx §5.4 'disabled (option not present)'). Key = tree node id, value = parameter id of the Option_* boolean or a key in seed/machine.json.

900.name: Diag_Recording_Enable
900.label: Diagnosis recording
900.why: docx §8.6 activation toggle has no parameter yet.

906.name: Reporting_QR_URL_Template
906.label: Reporting URL template
906.why: docx §8.11 'URL template must be configurable and is not in the parameter list yet'.

extraParams.$comment: Dummy ids for things the docx needs but the Excel does not define yet (recorded in OPEN-POINTS). Ids 900+ are outside the Excel range.
